Rules

  • Tokens come only from learning and have no cash value.
  • Spending tokens never lowers your badge level.
  • A missed day pauses your streak. It doesn’t reset it.
  • The daily spin is free once you learn, even with 0 tokens. Spins can’t be bought.
  • Hints work only in practice tests, never in evaluation or SAT tests.
  • Some avatar items unlock only at a badge level.
